svg.text: Six interlocking spatial + institutional layers; not one decorative corridor.

g.text: 1 Historical Memory — railway relation · Landmark as Memory · retirement archive
2 Movement & Access — walk · cycle · universal access · transit interfaces
3 Public Realm — plazas · civic rooms · active edges · analog refuge
4 Blue-Green Ecology — shade · water-sensitive design · heat resilience
5 Capability Nodes — N1–N7 Public Capability Interface network
6 Event & Operations — daily service · pilots · annual version release

svg.text: Permanent carrier → Adaptive module → Experimental pilot; all subject to public-value/risk authorization.
PROPOSED. Exact alignment, hosts and dimensions require verified site evidence.
